doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9 (segments in any order), FR-024: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/lenient-trailer.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. What follows a component's coordinates is segments in any order, each read by its node wherever it stands: inertia, 'label [-30, 12]' and '(build)' in one order on Ordered, 'label[ 5 , -7 ]' and '( market )' glued and spaced on Spaced, 'inertia(buy)' glued on Glued, 'url( linkedMap )' before '(ecosystem)' on Linked, and 'inertial', a word that is no segment, on Lookalike. Keywords are read in any case (COMPONENT, Component). A set of one segment changes only its own bytes.

steps.doc: Ordered's label offset is a replace-value of the label's numbers alone; (build) before it and inertia after it stay.
steps.expect:
title Lenient trailer
anchor User [0.95, 0.5]
component Ordered [0.8, 0.3] (build) label [-20, 8] inertia
component Spaced [0.7,0.4]  label[ 5 , -7 ]( market )
COMPONENT Shouted [0.6, 0.5]
component Glued [0.5, 0.6] inertia(buy)
component Linked [0.4, 0.7] url( linkedMap ) (ecosystem)
component Lookalike [0.3, 0.8] inertial
Component Cased [0.2, 0.2] INERTIA (Outsource)
url linkedMap [linked.owm]
User->Ordered

steps.doc: The undo puts the numbers back.
